BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 9-N in the area bounded by:

West Addison Street; a line 157 feet east of and parallel to North New Engand Avenue; the alley
next south of and parallel to W. Addison Street; and a line 57 feet east of and parallel to North
New England Avenue.

to those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 6845 W. Addison Street
